contract.review_scope: Body-level static contract; transitive application and called-module completeness are separate.
contract.purpose: Retrieve catch-weight unit candidates through inventory, item/class and generic fallback.
inputs_defaults: item nvarchar(50), company/warehouse/location/lot nvarchar(25), logisticsUnit nvarchar(50), internalLocationInv/invAttributeId numeric(9); no defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Supplied inventory ID is not cross-checked against requested item/location. TOP1 selections lack ordering. Final other-inventory fallback has no warehouse/location/lot constraint. Unknown/missing catch-weight item returns empty rather than generic options.
output_shape: Table weightUM nvarchar(25), description nvarchar(500), weight numeric(19,5) default0, source int default0; may be empty or multiple rows.

ordered_branches.explanation: Read item CATCH_WEIGHT_REQD; NULL or notY returns empty immediately.

Use positive supplied inventory ID directly. Otherwise locate TOP1 inventory by item/location/warehouse; positive attribute path joins inventory INTERNAL_LOCATION_INV to attribute OBJECT_ID, not inventory LOC_INV_ATTRIBUTES_ID.

Try distinct catch-weight rows for selected inventory, source1. If none, try sequence1 exact-company item units then companyNULL item units then item-class units, source2; substitute nonpositive/NULL UOM weight with1.
If still none, try TOP1 catch-weight row for item/company across all warehouses, source3. If none, return all active generic weight UMs with weight1/source4.
For found sources1..3 update local descriptions by generic-config identifier/group, without ACTIVE filter.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: No persistent status, inventory quantity or permissions mutation; output is the stated scalar or returned table.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: Stage precedence and source codes distinguish actual captured weight from configured default weight. Company/class selection can have multiple matches; no single preferred unit guaranteed.
error_and_return_handling: No explicit exception handler or application error code; conversion, arithmetic and called-function errors propagate.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit transaction, commit, rollback, savepoint, TRY/CATCH or XACT_ABORT is introduced by this body; caller/session semantics remain authoritative.
concurrency: No persistent mutation or lock protocol; reads, if any, follow caller/session isolation. Function result is not evidence of caller authorization or process execution.
contract.trigger_behavior: No persistent DML or DML trigger activation in this body.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Application caller, effective values and operational use remain unobserved.
